test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Hira inquired how I was doing being all alone in my house.

options.text: Hira said to me, “Are you doing fine being all alone in your house.”
Hira said to me, “How are you doing being all alone in my house.”
Hira said to me, “How are you doing being all alone in your house?”
Hira said to me, “How you are doing being all alone in your house?”

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Hira said to me, “How are you doing being all alone in your house?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is **option 3, "Hira said to me, 'How are you doing being all alone in your house?'"**
 
• The given sentence is in** indirect speech**, and we need to convert it into **direct speech**. In direct speech, we report someone's exact words using quotation marks. The
